ChannelMeeting.description: `meeting` on a meeting channel's JSON (Meet MC2a, CC6): the meeting it belongs to.

oneOf.description: An announcement channel: `@everyone` posts only in threads by default.
A 1:1 DM (no space, slug or name; always private).
A group DM of up to 9 people.
Every space member can see and join it.

description: A channel, DM or group DM.

assistant_reader_ids.description:
Assistants that read this DM or group DM through their pinned person (contracts rev 11
G21, S19 §8). Empty (and absent) for space channels.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

created_by.description:
Who created the channel (S10). Optional on the wire so older payloads still parse; the
server always sends it.

dm_member_ids.description: The DM's members; empty for space channels.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

file_retention_days.description: Effective file retention in days (S22 §14.3). Absent = forever.

has_guests.description:
At least one guest is a member (S19 §15): "this channel has guests" / "this
conversation has guests". Old payloads read as `false`.

head_seq.description: Head of the channel change log.

meeting.description: A meeting channel's meeting (Meet MC2a, CC6); absent on every other channel.

member_count.description: Joined members (S10). Old payloads without it read as 0.

recording_audio_days.description:
The channel's default audio keep days for recordings (S35 v2 §12.1); absent = the org
default.

recording_auto.description: Voice channels: a recording starts on the first join (S35 v2 §8.3). Absent = off.

recording_require_consent.description:
Voice channels: declining the recording notice means not joining (S35 v2 §9.11);
absent = the org policy `recording.require_consent_to_join`.

retention_days.description: Effective message retention in days (S22 §14.3; holds ignored). Absent = forever.

slow_mode_s.description: Slow mode in seconds, 0 = off (S12 §7). Always sent; old payloads read as 0.

user_limit.description:
Voice channels: at most this many people in the call, 0 = no per-channel limit (S33 v1
§10.4). Absent (0) for other types.

visibility.description: Public or private; DMs are private.

title: Channel
